The '''Seventh Army''', also known as '''Golden Nyss Command''', was a [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] and later [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Sector Army/Legends|Sector Army]] charged with the defense of the [[Immalia Oversector]].<ref name="TEGTW" />

During the Clone Wars, the 7th Sector Army was primarily a defensive command, charged with patrolling the [[Namadii Corridor/Legends|Namadii Corridor]] as far as [[Ansion/Legends|Ansion]] and the broad sweep of space between [[Dorin/Legends|Dorin]] and [[Bogden/Legends|Bogden]]. The Seventh also was frequently on standby to support the [[Fifth Deep Core Army|5th Sector Army]] against threats from the [[Unknown Regions/Legends|Unknown Regions]], and conducted secret scouting missions beyond the frontier.<ref name="TEGTW" />
